verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), and the docs say AI Gateway rules can be managed via API. This delivers the core of the story, but the evidence does not show that the spec specifically covers AI Gateway endpoints. Missing for 10: confirmation that the spec covers AI Gateway (config and inference endpoints), first-party docs describing the spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
